mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_ad_lease_detail WHERE ad_lease_id=#{leaseId} AND deleted=0)
SELECT attachment_id, original_filename, content_type, file_size, uploader_username, create_time FROM t_ad_lease_attachment WHERE ad_lease_id=#{leaseId} ORDER BY attachment_id DESC

SELECT attachment_id, ad_lease_id AS lease_id, original_filename, object_name, content_type, file_size, uploader_id, uploader_username FROM t_ad_lease_attachment WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND ad_lease_id=#{leaseId}
SELECT user_id FROM t_user WHERE username=#{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ad_lease_attachment (ad_lease_id, original_filename, object_name, content_type, file_size, uploader_id, uploader_username) VALUES (#{leaseId}, #{originalFilename}, #{objectName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderUsername})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_ad_lease_attachment WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND ad_lease_id=#{leaseId}
